geometry.geometry_revision: One open-ended knee joint: omit JSON end caps, retain 48 side panels / 76 crease chains, rigid square perimeters and continuous PET frame hinges
geometry.visual_hardware: Schematic 2 mm tall / 0.4 mm thick mounting bands only; not extra shell elements; lug/hole/guide dimensions unmeasured

frames.fea_frame: Origin lower perimeter center; Z upwards; source rotated +90 degrees about X and uniformly scaled from 250-unit width to 0.03 m
frames.isaac_frame: Same orientation plus recorded vertical display offset
frames.transform_fea_to_isaac: Identity rotation and scale; translation [0,0,offset] in saved calculation
frames.positive_angle_direction: Right-hand relative frame rotation vector, not independent Euler angles

material.model: Finite-rotation Green membrane strain / plane-stress StVK plus discrete hinges; uncalibrated
material.assumptions: User thicknesses; unmeasured elastic moduli, perfectly bonded isotropic PLA/PET. Material reference uses physical PET bending and zero extra crease coupling. PET pre-creasing/plasticity uncalibrated.

mesh.element_type: Triangular membrane with discrete bending hinges and explicit PET-only borders
mesh.mesh_revision: Boundary subdivision 1 / interior refinement 0 open side-panel mesh
mesh.convergence_summary: Topology and material controls checked; spatial convergence and full travel not established

boundary_conditions: Upper square perimeter fixed; lower perimeter displacement is prescribed in small continuation steps
Compression and bend use lower-frame translation; twist uses equivalent cable arc displacement
Reaction force/moment is recovered from the constrained FEM gradient after each accepted solve
Midsurface IPC disabled in the interactive displacement path; strain/intersection guards remain active
loads: 0.5 mm target displacement sweep for seven cable families; no force target

solver.software: Project NumPy/SciPy/Torch sparse nonlinear shell + IPC Toolkit 1.6.0 rendered in Isaac
solver.version: Implementation commit and source-file hashes in linked run manifest
solver.analysis_type: Quasistatic load continuation; separate implicit backward-Euler drop diagnostic
solver.notes: Actual elastic/cable/contact energy gradients; Gauss-Newton search tangent. Midsurface barrier and conservative curved-frame CCD, NOT finite-thickness contact. Impact numerical stopping target 1e-6; physical residual rejection remains 3e-5.

limitations: Full folding motion is not reproduced
Actual PET seam connectivity and cable guides unconfirmed
Creased-film plasticity, hysteresis, bonds and print anisotropy uncalibrated
Midsurface contact has no laminate thickness clearance, friction or cable contact
Impact benchmark only covers first 1 ms after contact; no survival or full-peak result
Narrow 0.2 mm flexure relative to 80 um film thickness requires shell-approximation and actual crease validation
Photo-informed topology, not exact manufactured hardware CAD
Display easing is not equilibrium, physical dynamics or a certified collision path; no intermediate stress results saved
Ideal rigid-facet audit has zero first-order mobility at neutral, but does not establish deformable-film behavior
This follow-up is a single joint model, not a whole-leg dynamics or native deformable-body model
Fold compliance control is an exploratory bending parameter, not a measured material property
Full compression, bend and twist travel remains unresolved; no strength or survival claim
Interactive displacement path disables midsurface contact for responsiveness
Target displacement is a kinematic continuation, not measured cable take-up

review.notes: Single-joint displacement UI and live FEM/reaction checks; not ML promotion.
